violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink at the bar. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination (raw chicken over raw park). Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026

Raw animal foods such as raw hamburgers were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as smoked and cured pork chops in the grill cooler refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets for 2 door reach-in were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink at the bar. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw wings) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as smoked cooked pork chops) in the grill cooler refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machines in the bar area and in kitchen were observed with an accumulation of pink and black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed. Ice machines must be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. All dishes and utensils to be washed, rinsed and sanitized in the 3 bay sink. Service was called during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026

Various foods in prep unit on the line were observed held at 45-65 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed; Foods recently purchased were placed into other refrigeration during time of inspection; reheated beef was observed at 65 degrees Fahrenheit. Per interview of staff, food was reheated around 10 AM this morning. Food was placed in ice bath to chill. Ambient of unit was 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was adjusted to a colder temperature during time of inspection and reached 34 degrees Fahrenheit. Establishment must monitor unit. If issues persist, service to be called. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/09/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets for 2 door reach-in were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Allergen advisory statement is not present on menus. Allergen advisory statement required to be present to notify consumers of their obligation to inform staff of any food allergies. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2025

Food contact surfaces of the icemachine in the kitchen were observed with an accumulation of pink residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Machine must be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to use. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Burgers and steaks are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. Once consumer advisory is added to menu, identifying symbol to be added with associated foods. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2025
The receptacles in toilet room are lacking covers. A toilet room shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary disposals. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher at the bar area was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 02/01/2024

Food contact surfaces of the ice machines at the kitchen and bar area observed with an accumulation of brown/black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 02/01/2024

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/01/2024
2 door refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/15/2024
